Note::regex¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

Note::RegexAccessor Note::regex() const noexcept

Enter The Pattern Operation Surface¶

regex() binds a lightweight regular-expression accessor to the current Note. It separates pattern interpretation from general literal text methods: contains() and replace() treat their arguments literally, while regex().search() and regex().replace() compile a pattern.

Obtaining the accessor does not compile a pattern, inspect text, allocate storage, or enlarge Note. The temporary proxy contains one pointer to the receiver; the terminal method performs the operation. Keep the receiver alive for the complete accessor call. Store the resulting Note or TokenBatch, not the borrowed accessor.

Open the Note Regex Accessor API Reference

Example: Select, Rewrite, Then Extract¶

const auto source = pluss::make_note({"A1,b22,,C333", "none"});
const auto has_number = source.regex().search(R"(\d+)");
const auto redacted = source.regex().replace(R"(\d+)", "#");
const auto numbers = source.regex().findall(R"(\d+)");

std::cout << pluss::note::print(has_number) << '\n';
std::cout << pluss::note::print(redacted) << '\n';
std::cout << pluss::note::print(numbers.tokens()) << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[2], dim=1, numel=2, dtype=Bool)
[true, false]
Note(shape=[2], dim=1, numel=2, encoding=utf8)
["A#,b#,,C#", "none"]
Note(shape=[3], dim=1, numel=3, encoding=utf8)
["1", "22", "333"]

The same source can feed several independent operations. Each terminal call compiles its own pattern; the accessor itself is only the public namespace.
